title: Traction for Neck and Back — What the Evidence Says

hook.en: Traction is one of physiotherapy's oldest treatments. A machine gently pulls the neck or spine, patients often say it feels good, and it is still in many clinics. But does the pull add anything beyond rest, advice and exercise? The research is clearer than the habit.
hook.ur: Traction physiotherapy ke sab se purane ilajon mein se hai. Machine narmi se gardan ya reerh ko kheenchti hai, mareez aksar kehte hain achha lagta hai, aur yeh ab bhi bohat se clinics mein hai. Lekin kya yeh khichaav aaram, mashwara aur exercise ke ilawa kuch jorta hai? Research aadat se zyada saaf hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll describe how traction is applied, summarise Cochrane evidence for low back pain with or without sciatica and for neck pain with or without radiculopathy, name when it might still be considered, apply safety checks and contraindications, and counsel patients honestly.
goal.ur: End tak aap bayan karenge ke traction kaise lagayi jati hai, sciatica ke saath ya baghair peeth ke dard aur radiculopathy ke saath ya baghair gardan ke dard ke liye Cochrane saboot ka khulasa karenge, batayenge kab bhi ghaur ho sakta hai, safety jaanch aur contraindications lagu karenge, aur mareezon ko imaandari se mashwara denge.

text.en: **Mechanical traction** applies a pulling force to the neck or lower back with a machine, a harness or a pulley, either continuously or intermittently, for minutes at a time. The idea is to separate the joint surfaces, relieve pressure on a nerve or disc, and reduce muscle guarding. **Manual traction** is done with the therapist's hands. Systematic reviews of randomised trials find that, for most patients with neck or low back pain, **traction gives little or no benefit** on pain, function or return to work compared with sham traction, other treatments or none.
text.ur: **Mechanical traction** gardan ya kamar ke neeche machine, harness ya pulley se khichaav ki taqat lagati hai, musalsal ya waqfay waqfay se, chand minute ke liye. Khayal yeh hai ke joint ki satahon ko alag kiya jaye, nas ya disc par dabao kam ho, aur muscle ki sakhti kam ho. **Manual traction** therapist ke haathon se hoti hai. Randomised trials ke systematic reviews paate hain ke gardan ya kamar ke dard wale zyada tar mareezon ke liye **traction dard, function ya kaam par wapsi mein kam ya koi faida nahi deti** sham traction, doosre ilajon ya kuch na karne ke muqabale mein.

text.en: Think of **stretching a stiff rubber band for a few minutes**. It feels like it loosens, but a minute later it is back to its usual length. Traction pulls the body for a short time, and the feeling of relief may be real, but the body does not stay "decompressed". Lasting change tends to come from movement, strength and time.
text.ur: **Sakht rubber band ko chand minute kheenchna** sochein. Lagta hai dheeli ho gayi, lekin ek minute baad apni aam lambai par wapas. Traction jism ko thori der ke liye kheenchti hai, aur aaram ka ehsas haqeeqi ho sakta hai, lekin jism "dabao se azaad" nahi rehta. Mustaqil tabdeeli harkat, taqat aur waqt se aati hai.

question.en: A patient with chronic low back pain asks, "Will a traction machine fix my disc?" What is the most honest answer?
question.ur: Chronic peeth dard ka mareez poochhta hai, "Kya traction machine meri disc theek karegi?" Sab se imaandar jawab kya hai?

text.en: "Trials suggest traction does not help back pain much more than other treatments or fake traction. Staying active and doing strengthening exercise has better support."
text.ur: "Trials ka ishara hai ke traction peeth dard mein doosre ilajon ya nakli traction se zyada madad nahi karti. Sargarm rehna aur taqat ki exercise ko behtar himayat hai."

feedback.en: Yes — honest and points to better-supported options.
feedback.ur: Haan — imaandar aur behtar himayat shuda options ki taraf ishara karta hai.

text.en: "Yes, traction pulls the disc back into place."
text.ur: "Haan, traction disc ko wapas jagah par kheenchti hai."

feedback.en: It is generally safe when screened properly.
feedback.ur: Sahi screening ke saath yeh aam taur par mehfooz hai.

question.en: Which patient should NOT have traction without medical clearance?
question.ur: Kis mareez ko tibbi manzoori ke baghair traction nahi honi chahiye?

text.en: A patient with suspected fracture, severe osteoporosis, infection, cancer, spinal instability, cord or cauda equina signs, or (for the neck) vascular concerns or severe rheumatoid disease of the neck
text.ur: Woh mareez jis mein fracture, shadeed osteoporosis, infection, cancer, reerh ki be-istiqrari, cord ya cauda equina ki nishaniyan, ya (gardan ke liye) rago ke masail ya gardan ki shadeed rheumatoid bimari ka shak ho

text.en: A healthy adult with mild back ache and no red flags
text.ur: Tandurust baalig jis ko halka peeth ka dard ho aur koi red flag nahi

feedback.en: They have no contraindication, but there is also little evidence for benefit.
feedback.ur: Un ko contraindication nahi, lekin faide ka saboot bhi kam hai.

text.en: Any patient who asks for it

feedback.ur: Darkhwast screening ki jagah nahi leti.

question.en: A clinic wants to buy a traction table, claiming it "decompresses discs". What is a sensible plan?
question.ur: Clinic traction table khareedna chahta hai, kehta hai yeh "disc ko dabao se azaad karti hai". Samajhdar plan kya hai?

text.ur: Usool ki bunyad par har machine radd karein

feedback.en: Judge by evidence, not by dislike of machines.
feedback.ur: Saboot se parkhein, machinon ki napasandeedgi se nahi.

text.en: Look at the reviews and cost; given the evidence, prioritise exercise, education and activity, and treat traction as an optional, rarely needed extra
text.ur: Reviews aur kharch dekhein; saboot ko dekhte hue exercise, taleem aur sargarmi ko tarjeeh dein, aur traction ko ikhtiyari, shayad hi zaroori izafa samjhein

feedback.en: Yes — evidence and cost should guide purchases.
feedback.ur: Haan — khareed ki rehnumai saboot aur kharch karein.

text.en: Buy it, because decompression sounds scientific
text.ur: Khareedein, kyunke decompression scientific lagta hai

text.en: **Using traction because a patient likes it, and letting it replace active care.** Comfort during traction is real, but it fades quickly and carries opportunity cost: time and money spent on a passive treatment instead of movement, strength and confidence. Also avoid "decompress", "pull back into place" and "bulging disc" language that frightens people. If a patient asks for traction, explain the evidence kindly and offer an active plan first.
text.ur: **Traction is liye dena ke mareez ko pasand hai, aur isay active care ki jagah lene dena.** Traction ke dauran aaram haqeeqi hai, lekin jaldi khatam hota hai aur is ki opportunity cost hai: harkat, taqat aur itminan ki jagah ghair active ilaaj par waqt aur paisa. "Decompress", "wapas jagah par kheenchna" aur "ubhri hui disc" ki zubaan se bhi bachein jo logon ko daraati hai. Agar mareez traction maange to narmi se saboot samjhayein aur pehle active plan dein.

text.en: **If you do use traction, do it carefully and review quickly.** Screen for red flags and contraindications, start with a light force, check comfort and symptoms during and after, stop for increased arm or leg symptoms, dizziness, nausea, or any new neurological sign. Set a clear stopping point: if there is no meaningful improvement in two to three sessions, stop and change the plan. Always combine it with activity and exercise, and record consent.
text.ur: **Agar traction istemal karein to ehtiyat se karein aur jaldi jaiza lein.** Red flags aur contraindications ki screening karein, halki taqat se shuru karein, dauran aur baad aaram aur alamaat dekhein, bazu ya taang ki alamaat barhne, chakkar, matli ya kisi nayi neurological nishani par ruk jayein. Rukne ka saaf nuqta tay karein: agar do se teen sessions mein koi ahem behtari na ho to ruk kar plan badlein. Hamesha sargarmi aur exercise ke saath milayein, aur razamandi record karein.

question.en: Why does traction feel good if it does not seem to help?
question.ur: Agar traction madad nahi karti lagti to achha kyun lagti hai?

answer.en: Gentle sustained pulling can relax muscles, the person is lying down and resting, someone is paying attention, and a warm, calm session reduces tension. Many back and neck problems also improve over weeks whatever is done, so the treatment gets credit for natural recovery. These effects are real and worthwhile, but they can be achieved with other things such as heat, relaxation, walking and reassurance, at lower cost.
answer.ur: Narm musalsal khichaav muscles ko dheela kar sakta hai, insaan lete hue aaram karta hai, koi tawajjo de raha hota hai, aur garm, pur-sukoon session tanao kam karta hai. Bohat si gardan aur peeth ki takleefein haftoon mein har soorat mein behtar ho jati hain, isliye ilaaj ko qudrati sehatyabi ka credit milta hai. Yeh asraat haqeeqi aur qeemti hain, lekin inhein doosri cheezon, jaise garmi, relaxation, chalna aur tasalli, se kam kharch par hasil kiya ja sakta hai.

beats.patient: A 55-year-old bank clerk has had low back pain with leg symptoms for two months and has had no red flags. A friend recommended traction. He asks if it is worth paying for ten sessions.
beats.assessment: The evidence does not support traction as a main treatment, and ten sessions is a large commitment for a small chance of benefit.
beats.treatment: The therapist explains the evidence, offers a plan of walking, graded strengthening, nerve-friendly movement and advice about sitting breaks, and says that if he really wants to try traction she would stop after three sessions without improvement.
beats.reassess: He chooses the active plan; by eight weeks his leg symptoms have mostly settled and he is back to normal work.

text.en: **Screen first, and stop early.** Red flags for the spine (unexplained weight loss, fever, night pain, history of cancer, trauma, progressive neurological loss, bladder or bowel changes, saddle numbness) need medical assessment before any traction. For the neck, also consider vascular risk, dizziness, severe arthritis of the neck, unstable joints and recent surgery. Avoid traction in pregnancy, severe osteoporosis, infection, tumours and fractures. Use the lowest effective force, and stop for increased symptoms.
text.ur: **Pehle screening karein, aur jaldi ruk jayein.** Reerh ke red flags (be-wajah wazan kam hona, bukhar, raat ka dard, cancer ki tareekh, chot, barhta hua neurological nuqsan, peshab ya paakhane mein tabdeeli, saddle ka sunn hona) ko kisi bhi traction se pehle tibbi assessment chahiye. Gardan ke liye rago ke khatre, chakkar, gardan ki shadeed arthritis, be-istiqrar joints aur haal ki surgery par bhi ghaur karein. Hamal, shadeed osteoporosis, infection, tumours aur fractures mein traction se bachein. Sab se kam mu'assir taqat istemal karein, aur alamaat barhne par ruk jayein.

text.en: A Cochrane review of traction for low-back pain with or without sciatica concluded, from trials of variable quality, that traction was probably not clinically effective: there was little or no impact on pain intensity, functional status, global improvement or return to work compared with placebo, sham, or other treatments, and that there was no evidence of benefit for people with sciatica. A Cochrane review of mechanical traction for neck pain with or without radiculopathy found that the evidence was limited and of low quality and gave no clear support for traction compared with sham or other treatments for pain, function or global effect.
text.ur: Sciatica ke saath ya baghair peeth ke dard ke liye traction ke ek Cochrane review ne, mukhtalif quality ke trials se, nateeja nikala ke traction shayad clinical taur par mu'assir nahi: placebo, sham ya doosre ilajon ke muqabale mein dard ki shiddat, functional halat, kul behtari ya kaam par wapsi par kam ya koi asar nahi tha, aur sciatica wale logon ke liye faide ka koi saboot nahi tha. Radiculopathy ke saath ya baghair gardan ke dard ke liye mechanical traction ke ek Cochrane review ne paya ke saboot mehdood aur kam quality ka tha aur sham ya doosre ilajon ke muqabale mein dard, function ya kul asar ke liye traction ki koi saaf himayat nahi di.

text.en: **Screen, Compare, Active first, Stop early.** Screen for red flags, compare with what we know, put active care first and stop early if it does not help.
text.ur: **Screen, Muqabla, Pehle active, Jaldi ruken.** Red flags ki screening karein, jo hum jaante hain us se muqabla karein, active care ko pehle rakhein aur faida na ho to jaldi ruk jayein.

summary.en: Reviews find little or no benefit of traction for low back pain (with or without sciatica) and neck pain compared with sham or other treatments.
summary.ur: Reviews peeth dard (sciatica ke saath ya baghair) aur gardan ke dard ke liye sham ya doosre ilajon ke muqabale mein traction ka kam ya koi faida nahi paate.

summary.en: It feels good for some, but comfort during treatment is not lasting benefit; active care has better support.
summary.ur: Kuch ko achha lagti hai, lekin ilaaj ke dauran aaram mustaqil faida nahi; active care ko behtar himayat hai.

summary.en: Screen red flags and contraindications, use light force, stop early and never let traction replace active care.
summary.ur: Red flags aur contraindications ki screening karein, halki taqat istemal karein, jaldi ruk jayein aur traction ko active care ki jagah kabhi na dein.

front.en: What does Cochrane say about traction for low back pain?
front.ur: Peeth dard ke liye traction par Cochrane kya kehta hai?

back.en: Little or no impact on pain, function or return to work.
back.ur: Dard, function ya kaam par wapsi par kam ya koi asar nahi.

back.en: Fracture, infection, cancer, severe osteoporosis or cord signs.
back.ur: Fracture, infection, cancer, shadeed osteoporosis ya cord ki nishaniyan.

front.en: Why does traction feel good for some?
front.ur: Kuch ko traction achha kyun lagti hai?

back.en: Relaxation, attention, resting position and expectation.
back.ur: Sukoon, tawajjo, aaram ki position aur umeed.

front.en: What should you do if traction does not help after a few sessions?
front.ur: Agar chand sessions ke baad traction se faida na ho to kya karein?

back.en: Stop and change to an active plan.
back.ur: Ruk jayein aur active plan par aa jayein.

note.ur: Nas se mutalliq alamaat ke liye active options.
